content: We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. No SMILES given. We need to infer from data? Possibly we need to get IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch. Or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons. But we don't have the compound identity. Maybe the system expects us to request IR spectra (which is good for C=O). Use ir_spectra tool. That will give IR peaks, we can count carbonyl peaks (~1700 cm-1). Let's call tool.
